channel.title: With Raspberry Pi
channel.description: Master Raspberry Pi with our comprehensive tutorials covering setup, programming, troubleshooting, and advanced projects. Perfect for beginners and experts alike.

item.title: Cluster Mastery: Multi-Node K3s Cluster on Raspberry Pi 5
item.description: Build a multi-node Kubernetes cluster using K3s on Raspberry Pi 5. Configure cgroups, set up active Traefik ingress, and integrate with local DNS routing.

item.title: Edge AI: Face and Object Recognition with Google Coral TPU & Frigate
item.description: Set up real-time face and object recognition on Raspberry Pi 5 with Google Coral USB Accelerator and Frigate NVR. Optimize hardware-accelerated detectors.

item.title: High-Performance Storage: Btrfs RAID 1 with Transparent Compression on Pi 5
item.description: Build a high-performance Btrfs RAID 1 storage array on Raspberry Pi 5. Optimize disk redundancy, enable transparent zstd compression, and manage snapshots.

item.title: Smart Home: Connecting Zigbee Devices to Home Assistant Container via Docker
item.description: Integrate Zigbee smart devices with Home Assistant Container on Raspberry Pi. Configure Zigbee2MQTT and Mosquitto Broker using Docker Compose.

item.title: Edge AI: Running Llama 3.1 on Raspberry Pi 5 with Ollama, Open WebUI, and RAG
item.description: Run Llama 3.1 on Raspberry Pi 5. Complete guide to setting up Ollama, Open WebUI, and a local RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) assistant using LangChain.

item.title: Home Lab: Self-Hosted Monitoring Dashboard on Raspberry Pi 5
item.description: Build a self-hosted home lab monitoring dashboard on Raspberry Pi 5. Step-by-step guide to deploying Netdata, Uptime Kuma, Prometheus, and Grafana using Docker Compose.

item.title: Network Mastery: Private DNS Server with AdGuard Home and Unbound over TLS
item.description: Set up a secure private DNS server on Raspberry Pi with AdGuard Home and Unbound. Configure DNS over TLS (DoT) to block ads and encrypt query traffic.

item.title: Retro Gaming: High-Performance PS2 and Sega Saturn Emulation on Raspberry Pi 5
item.description: Optimize Raspberry Pi 5 for PS2 and Sega Saturn emulation. Learn how to configure Vulkan graphics API, overclock the CPU, and install PCSX2/Yaba Sanshiro.

item.title: Edge AI: Building a Private Local AI Email Assistant on Raspberry Pi 5 with Ollama
item.description: Build a private AI email assistant on Raspberry Pi 5 with Ollama. Fetch emails via IMAP, categorize them with local LLMs, and send summaries to Discord.

item.title: Secure Infrastructure: Secure Remote Connections with WireGuard and Pi-hole on Raspberry Pi
item.description: Secure your remote connections and block ads on-the-go with WireGuard and Pi-hole on Raspberry Pi. Setting up PiVPN, DNS forwarding, and client profiles.

item.title: Storage Optimization: Btrfs File System with Transparent Compression and Snapshots on Raspberry Pi
item.description: Boost Raspberry Pi storage efficiency with the Btrfs file system. Learn to configure transparent zstd compression and create automated backups with snapshots.

item.title: Web Performance: High-Speed Nginx FastCGI Caching Optimization on Raspberry Pi 5
item.description: Supercharge web performance on Raspberry Pi 5 with Nginx FastCGI caching. Learn to cache dynamic requests in RAM (tmpfs) for near-instant load times.

item.title: Inline Assembly in C++ on Raspberry Pi
item.description: Master inline assembly in C++ on Raspberry Pi. Learn how to write assembly within C++ code, bind variables, use constraints, and optimize critical paths.

item.title: NEON SIMD Vector Programming on Arm64
item.description: Learn NEON SIMD vector programming on Raspberry Pi. Master parallel data processing, floating-point operations, and optimize performance for image processing.

item.title: Storage Management for Raspberry Pi
item.description: Master Raspberry Pi storage management. Learn SD card optimization, USB/NVMe SSD setup, partition management, filesystem selection, and backup strategies.

item.title: User and Permission Management for Raspberry Pi
item.description: Master user and permission management on Raspberry Pi. Learn account creation, sudo configuration, group management, SSH key setup, and security best practices.
